liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Predator X**: back after 25 archived shows (377 days) [6]
- **Am I in Heaven?**: back after 35 archived shows (440 days) [6]
- **Stressin'**: back after 31 archived shows (432 days); rare: 13 archived performances [6]
- **Open Water**: back after 22 archived shows (369 days) [6]
- **Ataraxia**: back after 68 archived shows (707 days) [6]
- **Honey**: back after 41 archived shows (448 days) [6]
- **Sleep Drifter**: back after 41 archived shows (448 days) [6]
- **Smoke & Mirrors**: rare: 9 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **kglw2026-08-14.matrix.flac24** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 179 min [1]
- **kglw2026-08-14.discocape-4channel**: source not stated; 22 songs; 184 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **kglw2026-08-14.dpa4006.flac24**: source not stated; 22 songs; 179 min [3]
- **kglw2026-08-14**: source not stated; 22 songs; 185 min [4]

## Around the show

- Mash and guyforget provided taping support for the front rail recording [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2026-08-14.matrix.flac24**: taped by Brian Porter; Scott Schneider; source: Schoeps MK21 ORTF-wide > Kcy > Sonosax SX-M2/LS2 > Sony M10 (24/96) + DPA 4006C with 30 mm APE spheres NOS > Sonosax M2D2 AES > Sound Devices 744T (24/96) +… [1]. Also: Hybrid mix uses native 24/96 audience recordings plus a filtered YouTube layer [1]
- **kglw2026-08-14.discocape-4channel**: taped by discocape; transferred by discocape; source: mk21 + km184 [2]. Also: Discocape taped and transferred the show using Schoeps and Neumann microphones [2]
- **kglw2026-08-14.dpa4006.flac24**: taped by Scott Schneider; transferred by Scott Schneider; source: DPA 4006c w/30mm APE spheres(NOS/LOC at corner of FOH enclosure/10')->Sonosax M2D2(aes)->SD744T(24bit/96kHz) [3]. Also: Audio captured at 24-bit/96kHz via Sonosax M2D2 and SD744T [3]
- **kglw2026-08-14**: taped by Birds; transferred by Birds; source: x2 Rode NT5 in ORTF > H6 Handy Recorder [4]. Also: Rode NT5 microphones recorded to H6, then converted to WAV and FLAC [4]
